project.name: Mat The - Sinh Hoa Nguy Co
rules: Luon push code moi nhat len GitHub va kich hoat lai deploy Vercel/Render sau khi chot thay doi can phat hanh.

Khong duoc dung Set-Content, Out-File hoac lenh ghi file tuong tu de sua source code hien co, dac biet voi file lon hoac file co Unicode. Chi duoc sua bang apply_patch de tranh mojibake va loi encoding.
Neu nghi ngo file vua bi mojibake hoac encoding drift sau thao tac ghi file, phai dung ngay, doi chieu voi git HEAD va khoi phuc file sach truoc khi tiep tuc sua.

backend.note: Oracle/translation production debugging phai doi chieu endpoint live va commit deploy, khong duoc gia dinh push GitHub da len server.

current_focus.summary: Session nay tap trung vao do on dinh cua AI translation va trai nghiem hoc ngoai ngu khi doc truyen. Da quet du lieu production, retranslate chon loc chapter translations bi sai locale, fix tan goc loi batch chapter title not-null khi ghi trang thai failed, them tra tu nhanh trong trang doc, va them audio floating controls cung hotkeys.

gotchas.title: Do not paste git diff into Supabase SQL Editor
gotchas.detail: Supabase accepts raw SQL only. Patch text starting with diff --git will fail with syntax error 42601.

gotchas.title: HTTP 200 does not guarantee usable Oracle output
gotchas.detail: Gemini can return successful but semantically broken/truncated text; backend must validate answer quality.

gotchas.title: Oracle cache can preserve bad answers
gotchas.detail: Stale rows in oracle_cache can poison UX even after model and deployment issues are fixed.

gotchas.title: Floating reader controls need adaptive placement
gotchas.detail: Fixed-corner placement is fragile on mobile; draggable or floating controls need overlap checks with existing reader HUD.

gotchas.title: Translation success can fail on JSON parsing even with HTTP 200
gotchas.detail: Gemini may return JSON wrapped in fences, include control characters, or produce malformed strings. Structured schema flow is safer than free-form JSON parsing.

gotchas.title: Postgres upsert still checks NOT NULL before conflict resolution
gotchas.detail: Trong chapter_translations, neu nhanh failed upsert khong truyen title/content, Postgres van no null value violates not-null constraint du row cu da ton tai.

gotchas.title: Mojibake va wrong-locale la hai loai loi khac nhau
gotchas.detail: Production scan cho thay DB khong bi mojibake hang loat. Van de thuc te la mot so chapter translations cho en/zh-CN/ja van chua tieng Viet hoac sai locale.

gotchas.title: Reader lookup tot nhat la in-page contextual lookup
gotchas.detail: Cho nguoi hoc ngoai ngu qua truyen, UX tot nhat la boi den tu/cum, mo panel tra nhanh ngay trong trang, giai nghia ngan gon theo ngu canh, roi moi mo tu dien ngoai neu can.

gotchas.title: Audio controls o dau bai la khong du
gotchas.detail: Nguoi dung thuong doc sau xuong duoi trang, nen can mini-controller noi va hotkeys de play/pause/replay ma khong can keo len dau trang.

gotchas.title: Khong sua file source bang Set-Content tren Windows
gotchas.detail: Set-Content/Out-File co the lam lech encoding, them BOM hoac gay mojibake tren file lon nhieu Unicode. Quy tac cua repo nay la chi dung apply_patch cho sua source hien co.
